limitations: One host, loopback; wrk and the origin run on the load CPU set, the daemon on its own set.
wrk is a closed-loop generator: its latency percentiles suffer coordinated omission under saturation. `bench latency` measures latency at equal offered load instead.
CPU time is user+system time of the daemon process from /proc/<pid>/stat (10 ms ticks), read before and after each run; the origin's CPU is not included.
Peak RSS is VmHWM after resetting it through /proc/<pid>/clear_refs before each run.
Hashcash at 8 bits with a session solved once per case; browser solve time is not measured.
No TLS, no WAN, no real browsers; a ranking on this host is not a ranking on yours.
